title: Two keys. Five minutes.
sub: Where to get what Social Media Automation asks for

label: Key 1 of 2
title: Buffer API key
sub: Buffer is what posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X

title: Make a free Buffer account at buffer.com
note: Then open the email Buffer sends you and verify it. The API page stays locked until you do.

title: Pick where to post and log in there
note: Instagram: use a Business or Creator account, so posts go out by themselves. Free plan: 3 channels.

title: Expiration: pick 1 year
note: The key stops working when it expires. After a year, make a new one and paste it again. Leave every permission ticked.

title: Copy the key
note: Hidden here. It is a password: never send it to anyone, never put it on GitHub.

title: Paste it in the app: Connect tab → Buffer key

label: Key 2 of 2
title: Cloudflare token
sub: Cloudflare keeps your pictures and videos online so Buffer can fetch them. Free, no card.

title: Make a free account at dash.cloudflare.com
Permissions: Account · Cloudflare Pages · Edit
note: Add nothing else. Leave Account Resources on All accounts.

title: Copy the token now
note: Hidden here. Cloudflare shows it only once. Lost it? Make a new one.

title: Paste it in the app, then Check and save

label: Keep them safe
title: Your keys are passwords
sub: They stay in .env.local on your computer. Never send that file to anyone, never put it on GitHub.

title: That's it.
sub: Next: Project tab, paste your website, then Make and schedule a week.
